beats.narration_says: The Gauls had taken every street in Rome. Only the Capitoline still held, and its cliff was the last wall the city had left.
beats.viewer_sees: A chieftain climbing the cliff face at dawn, the temple above him small and far off — the whole city reduced to one rock.

visual_priority: Brennus large and near-camera against the cliff
the Capitoline outcrop and its temple roof
the low angle that makes the climb read
the overcast dawn without hard shadow
shots.image_prompt:
STYLE: painterly 2D historical illustration, warm muted palette, soft volumetric light.
SUBJECT: Brennus, a broad-shouldered Gallic chieftain in his forties, long red-blond hair in a thick braid, drooping moustache, a bronze torc at his throat, chainmail over a red woollen tunic.
SETTING: a steep rocky outcrop above the Forum, its flank a sheer pale cliff, crowned by a squat temple with a red-tiled roof and a low defensive wall of rough tufa blocks.
CAMERA: camera stands on the paved slope below the cliff, low angle, wide.
FRAME LAYOUT: left third — Brennus, large and near-camera; upper-right — the temple roof, small and hazy; centre — bare wet rock.
FACING: we see his face and chest, his eyes lifted past camera.
SCREEN DIRECTION: he climbs from the lower-left edge toward the upper-right.
LIGHT: thin overcast dawn, no hard shadows.
PALETTE: slate grey, cold bronze, one note of dull red.
DETAIL: layered rock shelves and tufa block joints, figures readable by outline, wet sheen on the bare stone.
NOT IN FRAME: the Forum, Roman soldiers.
shots.animation_prompt:
MOTION BUDGET: key motion completes within 7.25s.
0-1s: Brennus plants a boot on the rock and shifts his weight upward.
1-4s: he climbs three slow steps, the braid swinging, his breath clouding in the cold air.
4-7.25s: he settles onto a ledge, shoulders rising and falling, and holds still.
CAMERA: one continuous slow push toward him.
ENVIRONMENT: thin mist drifts across the cliff face; loose grit slides underfoot.
PRESERVE: same characters, clothing, props, architecture, palette and composition as the source image.
FORBID: cuts, scene changes, new characters, on-screen text, camera teleports, style shifts.

beats.narration_says: What saved Rome that night was not a sword. It was a price, weighed out in bronze.
beats.viewer_sees: MACRO OBJECT — coins dropping one at a time into a balance pan until the chains pull tight. No people, no swords.

visual_priority: the bronze scales tipping under the weight
the coins sliding across the near pan
the single raking lamp from the left
the crossbeam dark and out of focus
